canonical_recipe: 将照片重绘为黏土定格动画场景，保留主体与构图，圆润手工造型、可见黏土纹理与柔和自然光。
actual_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: standalone AI style demo derivative for a photo styling app.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY edit target, the original pour-over coffee photograph. Image 2 is a supporting MATERIAL STYLE reference only, a fjord recreated entirely in handmade colored clay. Apply the same clay material language to the coffee scene, without copying the fjord subject, palette or wide aspect ratio.
Primary request: 将照片重绘为黏土定格动画场景，保留主体与构图，圆润手工造型、可见黏土纹理与柔和自然光。
Recreate Image 1 as an artisan handmade clay stop-motion miniature. Preserve the photograph's arrangement and camera viewpoint: central hourglass pour-over coffee brewer with dark coffee in the lower bulb, brown collar and dangling cord, folded ivory filter above; a rounded gooseneck pouring kettle held by a hand at the upper right, its curved spout and falling water drops aimed into the filter; the secondary brewer behind right, small cup at lower left, dark foreground shapes and window-lit cafe background. Every object must be visibly recreated from hand molded colored modeling clay, including glass-like areas interpreted as light translucent or pale clay forms with dark coffee visible as a clay layer. Rounded tactile forms, subtle fingerprints, pressed tool marks, slightly irregular hand made edges, matte surfaces and small natural shadows. The kettle is metallic-grey clay with a black clay knob. Soft natural window lighting and the original calm dark teal, charcoal, ivory and warm coffee browns. A radical physical clay scene, not a photographic filter.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1's 9:7 landscape aspect ratio, about 1422x1106 or nearest supported size. Full bleed standalone scene.
Constraints: no interface, no words, no readable signs, no labels, no split comparison, no frame, no border, no watermark. Opaque background.
inspection: Accepted: clay material across kettle, brewer, hand and background; central brewer, pouring kettle and source composition preserved visually; no interface, words, border or watermark. Exact 9:7 aspect ratio. Not pixel-identical.
